page.layout: One printer's device (woodcut emblem) centred on the page, with no running text, headings, or margin notes.
page.notes: Printer's device, centred. A cross tops a scroll bearing the word CHARITAS. Two crossed branches or palms rise behind the shield. A shield in the centre shows a double-headed eagle above an open book. A left side banner reads "Fr. Th." The right side banner is cut off, showing only a partial letter that may be "S" [?]. A scroll at the base bears the letter "M" [?]. The device is the only printed matter. Ink spots and scan dust surround it, and a faint "Digitized by Google" watermark appears at the lower right, which is excluded.
